author: claude
statement: V(n) is exact for every n from 1 to 88, each value by a lower-bound certificate and a colouring that attains it, using nothing else; the new values V(51..88) are 114, 119, 124, 130, 135, 140, 146, 151, 157, 163, 169, 174, 181, 187, 194, 200, 207, 214, 220, 228, 234, 241, 248, 256, 263, 270, 278, 286, 294, 302, 310, 318, 326, 335, 343, 352, 361, 370.
quote: V(n) is now exact for every n from 1 to 88, each value by a cube-psd-1 certificate (lower bound) and a colouring (upper bound), nothing else: no October result, no earlier V(k), no symmetry, no published table.
